_comment: How the optimizer makes a stylesheet non-render-blocking, in one place.
The deferred <link> ships as rel="preload" as="style", with the real media
parked in data-pagespeed-media; the loader flips rel back to "stylesheet"
and restores the media. Both lanes read this file — the markup lane through
conftest.py, the rendered lane through probe_rendered.mjs — so the lanes
RECORD the primitive rather than hardcoding it.
primitive_attr/primitive_value is the ONE attribute the rendered lane sets
to put an applied sheet back to not-applying (rel=preload un-applies a
stylesheet, as media=print did). primitive_as is the companion attribute:
the markup lane asserts it, and it is what makes the preload match the
consumer the loader creates — without it the sheet downloads twice.
early_hint_promoted is true: the primitive is itself a preload, so an Early
Hint promotes exactly what the transform promoted.
